## Problem
`e2e-auto-approve-proposals` fails when it runs in the same `bun test` process as `credential-free-ai-results`; each file passes on its own. Reproduced with and without the changes of PR #1539, so it predates it. Some shared state (env, module-level cache or a global) leaks between the two files.

## Expected
Find the leaked state and fix it so the files pass in any order and grouping (CLAUDE.md §4: fix the race, do not retry).

## Notes
Seen locally by the agent working on #1538 / PR #1539.

body:
## Context

**Design:** [`docs/design/permission-preview.md`](https://github.com/njdaniel/conch/blob/main/docs/design/permission-preview.md) §8, listed in §10 as P8. **Design accepted by Nick on 2026-11-07, recorded on #1007.** He took §9's recommendations except point 5: the role simulation (§8) is in scope now, as its own issue (#1519), because he asked to see the view of roles as well as people. PR #1502 records the acceptance in the document. Until it merges, main's copy still reads "Proposed", and its §2 and §10 still call the simulation optional.

**Why it is in scope.** The design shipped the member preview only and recommended the role simulation for later (§9 point 5). Nick set that aside on 2026-11-07, because he wants to see the view of roles as well as people. This issue builds §8 on top of the member preview (#1515, #1517, #1518).

**What it is, and what it is not.** A member preview is the view of a named person: their memberships, manager grants, brakes and links. A role simulation is the view of nobody in particular: "what does a brand-new member (or operator) see?" It must never be mistaken for a person's view, and §8 says so.

**The server.**

- **The header.** A second header, `Conch-Preview-Role: member` or `operator`.
  - It is never combined with `Conch-Preview-As`: both present is 400 `invalid_request`.
  - Any other value is 400 `invalid_request`.
  - It goes through the same `guard` step as #1515. The allowlist runs first, so a non-previewable route gets 403 `preview_read_only`. The caller rule is then §3.1's: human, not a guest, holding `manage_members` and `manage_channels`.
  - There is no target lookup and no owner protection, because there is no person.
- **The synthetic principal.** `store.Principal{ID: 0, Kind: human, Role: <role>}`, held in memory, with no brakes, no memberships beyond the default channels and no joiners. The same five reads answer for it:
  - `GET /v1/channels` lists the default channels, which is what a link joiner lands in.
  - `GET /v1/directory/channels` lists public channels, with `joined` true on the default ones.
  - `GET /v1/directory/members` is the may-know set of someone sharing the default channels. If the role's cell holds `see_member_directory`, it is everyone.
  - `GET /v1/channels/{channel}/members` answers as a member for a default channel, and otherwise as `channelMembersGate` would for the role. That means 404, unless the role's cells hold `manage_channels`.
  - `GET /v1/preview` answers `PreviewResponseV1`:
    - id 0, kind `human`, the role, owner false;
    - `permissions` from the role's cells;
    - `may_invite` and `voice_allowed` as whoami would answer for a new principal of that role with no brakes;
    - the new optional field `simulation: "role"`;
    - the `name`: proposed as the empty string, with clients labelling it. Confirm in review.
- **The audit.** `preview_viewed` with subject `role:member` or `role:operator`. The actor is the administrator.
- **The invariant** (§3.2). A simulation shows less than a preview, never more, and nothing is written.

**A gap in the design that this issue settles.** §8 names only `knownPrincipalsSQL` and `ListChannelsForPrincipal` as needing an id-0 branch. But `can(ctx, caller, perm)` resolves **by id** through `store.Permitted`, and id 0 is no row, so under a plain swap the synthetic principal would hold nothing. Under a role simulation, `can` must answer from `store.HeldBy(ctx, synthetic, perm)`, which reads the document's role cells for an already-built `Principal`. Every `HeldBy` caller must get the same answer.
- Do **not** edit `permittedTx`, `principalHolds` or `internal/server/store/permissions.go`. They are on the approval path, and `HeldBy` already serves.
- If the implementation finds it must edit them, relabel the PR `approval-path`, add `go run ./e2e/dogfood` to its tests, and Nick merges it.
- `TestActorAuthorityReadsPermissions` must still pass.

**The browser** (extends #1517).
- **Entry.** The admin console's Roles and permissions section (`web/src/admin/PermissionsSection.tsx`) gains "Simulate a new member" and "Simulate a new operator". *Proposed:* the design does not name the entry point.
- **The store.** The same preview store, and `previewAs` generalised to `{ id } | { role }`. The header rule is unchanged: set per call, never ambient.
- **The banner,** in these words: "Simulating a new member. This is not any person's view: it ignores individual channels, manager grants, brakes and links." Use "operator" in place of "member" for the operator role.
- **The label.** `simulation === "role"` is what selects the banner. A simulation is never labelled with a person's name.

**The CLI** (extends #1518). *Proposed:* the design does not name the flags.
- `conch admin preview --role member|operator`, mutually exclusive with `<member>`.
- `--preview-role` beside `--preview-as` on `conch channels list` and `conch admin directory members`. The two flags are mutually exclusive.

**Isolation** (extends #1516). The preview phase gains role-header rows:
- every non-previewable route refuses `Conch-Preview-Role` with `preview_read_only`;
- both headers together is 400;
- the restricted-operator prober gets `permission_denied`;
- a simulated member's answers contain no marker of a non-default private channel.

**Schema:** additive. `PreviewResponseV1.Simulation string json:"simulation,omitempty"` and the constant `PreviewSimulationRole = "role"`; no version bump.

**Security:** a `security-reviewer` pass before merge. **Approval-path:** no, as long as `store/permissions.go` is untouched (above).

**Size.** This spans schema, server, web and CLI in one issue, as Nick asked for "its own slice". If it proves too large for one PR, split it into server+schema+isolation first and web+CLI after. Record the split on this issue.

## Files

- **Schema:**
  - `pkg/schema/preview.go`: `Simulation` and `PreviewSimulationRole`.
  - `pkg/schema/testdata/preview-response-v1-simulation.json`.
  - `pkg/schema/ts.go`: the fixture in the family.
  - Regenerated `web/src/schema/generated*.ts`.
  - `pkg/schema/preview_test.go`.
- **Server:**
  - `internal/server/auth.go`: the `guard` step reads the second header; exclusivity; `can` under simulation, through `HeldBy`.
  - `internal/server/preview.go`: the synthetic principal and the simulated summary.
  - `internal/server/store/directory.go`: `knownPrincipalsSQL` and `knowsCond`, with a default-channels branch for id 0.
  - `internal/server/store/members.go`: `ListChannelsForPrincipal` for id 0.
  - `internal/server/store/channels_self.go`: `ChannelDirectory`'s `joined` for id 0.
  - `internal/server/members.go`: `channelMembersGate` and `callerIsMember` for id 0.
  - Tests: `internal/server/preview_test.go` and `preview_guard_test.go`.
- **Web:**
  - `web/src/api.ts` and `web/src/platform/operations.ts`;
  - `web/src/App.tsx`;
  - `web/src/PreviewBanner.tsx`;
  - `web/src/admin/PermissionsSection.tsx`;
  - their tests;
  - the preview Playwright spec from #1517.
- **CLI:** `internal/cli/admin_preview.go`, `internal/cli/channels.go`, the `admin directory members` command, and their tests.
- **Isolation:** `e2e/isolation/preview.go`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `Conch-Preview-Role: member` on `GET /v1/preview` answers `simulation: "role"`, id 0, role `member`, `permissions` equal to the member column of the current document (no brakes), and writes `preview_viewed` with subject `role:member`. The same holds for `operator`.
- [ ] Under each preset, with one default channel D and private channels A and B:
  - a simulated member's `GET /v1/channels` is [D];
  - its directory of channels lists the public channels, with D joined;
  - its member directory is the members of D, or everyone when the role's cell holds `see_member_directory`;
  - `GET /v1/channels/A/members` is 404, byte-identical to a ghost channel.
- [ ] Both headers together is 400. An unknown role is 400. A non-previewable route with the role header is 403 `preview_read_only`, with no other check run. A caller without both permissions is refused as in §3.1.
- [ ] Under simulation, every `can()` answer equals `store.HeldBy` for the synthetic principal. No call reaches `store.Permitted` with id 0, and `internal/server/store/permissions.go` is unchanged.
- [ ] Nothing is written apart from the one `preview_viewed` row. No row has id 0 as an actor or a subject.
- [ ] The browser offers "Simulate a new member" and "Simulate a new operator" from Roles and permissions. It shows the §8 banner text, and it renders through the same helpers and teardown as #1517. A simulation never shows a person's name as its subject.
- [ ] `conch admin preview --role member` prints the simulated role's permissions, channels and directory scope. `--role` together with a member argument is a usage error. `--preview-role` and `--preview-as` are mutually exclusive.
- [ ] `e2e/isolation`'s preview phase has the role-header rows above, and `TestEveryRouteHasARow` stays green.
- [ ] `make check` and `make web-check` are clean. No new dependency.

## Required tests

- **Schema:** a golden test for the simulation fixture.
- **Server:**
  - a table over role {member, operator} × preset {personal, group} × the five reads, against a hand-built world;
  - header exclusivity and bad values;
  - a test that under simulation `can()` agrees with `HeldBy` for every catalog permission;
  - the side-effect diff, as #1515 has;
  - the audit row.
- **Web:**
  - unit tests for the entry, the banner and the header rule (a role-header call is never ambient);
  - a Playwright case: the owner simulates a new member, sees D only, sees the banner, and exits.
- **CLI:** table-driven tests against a fake server.
- **Isolation:** `go run ./e2e/isolation` with the role rows.
- A `security-reviewer` pass.

## Blocked by

- #1516 (merged): this issue extends its isolation phase. #1516 also brings in #1515.
- #1517 (merged).
- #1518 (merged).
title: Preview as role: simulate a new member or operator (Conch-Preview-Role)
